sn35.142:1.2: The cause and condition for the arising of the eye is also nonself.
sn35.142:1.3: As the eye has originated from what is nonself, how could it be self?
sn35.142:1.8: The cause and condition for the arising of the mind is also nonself.
sn35.142:1.9: As the mind has originated from what is nonself, how could it be self?
sn35.142:1.11: He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’”
